name: Zhejiang Laifual Drive Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Laifual Drive Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells robotic precision transmission components. The company offers products, such as harmonic reducers, joint modules, robotic arms, and automated workstations. The company serves industries, including robotics, imaging and medical equipment, 3C and semiconductors, non-standard equipment, and machine tools. It operates in the People's Republic of China, Europe, the United States, Japan, Korea, and Hong Kong. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Shengzhou, China.
